n, k = map(int, input().split())
array = list(map(int, input().split()))

evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0
diffList = []

for i in range(n):
    if i != 0:
        if evenCount == oddCount:
            diffList.append(abs(array[i] - array[i - 1]))
    if array[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1

diffList.sort()

count = 0
for diff in diffList:
    if diff <= k:
        count += 1
        k -= diff
    else:
        break

print(count)
</translated_code>
